authorization: User approved the proposed OMI dropout/epoch selection, logistic tuning and raw 12-lead CNN comparison on 2026-10-23.
split: reuse sensitivity-study subfit/calibration/validation exactly; no official test waveforms

inner.selection: pooled inner out-of-fold average precision, averaged over all three neural seeds
inner.ties: earlier epoch, then zero dropout; logistic smaller C

sampling.method: all originals plus random minority duplication to equal class counts

training.schedule: cosine horizon 40, including earlier stopped refits

raw_model.input: 5000 samples x 12 leads at native 500 Hz, physical mV
raw_model.normalization: per-lead population mean/std across unique fitting records and samples; no per-record standardization
raw_model.stem: Conv1d 12->16 kernel15 stride4 padding7, GroupNorm4, GELU
raw_model.blocks: residual 16->32 stride2, 32->64 stride2, 64->64 stride2; kernel7 padding3, GroupNorm4 and GELU; 1x1 skip
raw_model.head: global temporal mean, dropout0.1, linear64->2

evaluation.primary: selected Swin minus matched fixed-40 Swin average precision
evaluation.secondary: each arm versus tuned logistic, raw CNN versus selected Swin; all seeds and per-class/confusion metrics
evaluation.thresholds: largest calibration score meeting target, ties included; freeze before validation inference; no refit afterward

reuse: verified sensitivity-study fixed C=1 logistic and fixed-40 zero-dropout Swin on identical subfit/calibration; reuse zero-dropout final Swin only if epoch40 selected
limits: Existing validation repeatedly examined. Intervals condition on fitted models, chosen settings and cutoffs, excluding retraining/selection uncertainty. Raw CNN changes both representation and classifier. This is not a replication of a published model. No promised accuracy or clinical validity.
